metadata.title: Complete Flow
metadata.purposeAndUsage: MANDATORY final step for every flow. Deletes the artifact files the steps made, then marks the flow completed. The status tool records the completion time and moves the folder. Auto-injected by the framework at flow creation time.

output.description: The flow is completed and its folder is in completed/

specificActions: Delete every file in the flow folder that is not flow.json, log.json or the memory/ folder
Call the tool update_flow_status with status 'completed'. The tool records the completion time and moves the folder to completed/. A sub-flow must also pass a summary.
bestPractices: Delete the files before the status call: the tool moves the folder, and the path changes
Never delete flow.json, log.json or memory/

substeps.name: Clean Up Artifact Files
substeps.description: Delete the files the steps made, keeping only the flow files
actions: List all files in the flow folder
Define the allowlist of items to KEEP: ["flow.json", "memory/", "log.json"]
Delete all files NOT in the allowlist (*.md files, other *.json artifacts). Keep the memory/ folder intact
Verify only flow.json, memory/ and log.json remain
Output: '✓ Artifact files cleaned up - keeping only flow.json, memory/, log.json'

substeps.name: Mark the Flow Completed
substeps.description: Call the status tool: it records the completion time and moves the folder
actions: Call the tool update_flow_status with the flow folder and status 'completed' (a sub-flow also passes a summary of what it did)
Read relocated_to in the answer: that is the new folder
Output: '✓ Flow completed and moved to {relocated_to}'

flow.description: Delete artifact files → Mark the flow completed (the tool records the time and moves the folder)
